layout_structure.right_container: absolute top-4 right-4 z-20 flex flex-col gap-3 w-80 max-h-[calc(100vh-140px)] overflow-y-auto

identified_collisions.description: Left scientific controls panel (width 320px) completely covers the top-left 3D viewport telemetry HUD (top-4 left-4 min-w-[300px]), making FPS, variable range, and bounds invisible.
Seven analytical panels stacked in a single vertical column exceed 1800px total height, causing severe vertical truncation and forcing inner scrollbars that interfere with canvas interaction.
Bottom of the right floating container collides with the timeline controller scrubber bar, obscuring the day 7 timeline scrubber tick.

accessibility_audit_wcag21_aa.focus_management: Partial (TimelineController has tabIndex=0, but floating panels lack unified keyboard trap boundaries)
accessibility_audit_wcag21_aa.contrast_ratios: Slate-900 on Slate-950 borders have contrast ratio < 3.0:1 in secondary headers
accessibility_audit_wcag21_aa.screen_reader_landmarks: Header, Main, and Timeline region landmarks present; inner canvas lacks aria-live telemetry region.
